user.title: Connect to your Livebox
user.description: Enter the connection settings of your Orange Livebox.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Livebox, usually 192.168.1.1.
data_description.username: Administrator account of the Livebox, usually admin.
data_description.password: Administrator password, printed on the Livebox label by default.
data_description.port: Port of the Livebox web interface (80 over HTTP, 443 over HTTPS).
data_description.use_tls: Connect to the Livebox over HTTPS.
data_description.verify_tls: Check the certificate presented by the Livebox. Disable it for a self-signed certificate.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure your Livebox
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings of your Orange Livebox.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Livebox, usually 192.168.1.1.
data_description.username: Administrator account of the Livebox, usually admin.
data_description.password: Administrator password, printed on the Livebox label by default.
data_description.port: Port of the Livebox web interface (80 over HTTP, 443 over HTTPS).
data_description.use_tls: Connect to the Livebox over HTTPS.
data_description.verify_tls: Check the certificate presented by the Livebox. Disable it for a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Authenticate again
reauth_confirm.description: The Livebox {name} rejected the credentials. Enter the current administrator password.

data_description.username: Administrator account of the Livebox, usually admin.
data_description.password: Administrator password, printed on the Livebox label by default.

error.insufficient_permission: The account does not have enough permissions on the Livebox.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Livebox.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The new settings point to a different Livebox.

init.title: Device tracking
init.description: Choose which devices connected to the Livebox are tracked.

data_description.lan_tracking: Create a device tracker for each device connected by cable.
data_description.wifi_tracking: Create a device tracker for each device connected over Wi-Fi.
data_description.timeout_tracking: Delay, in seconds, before a disconnected device is considered away.
data_description.device_tracker_mode: Track only the devices currently connected, or every device known by the Livebox.
data_description.wan_access_switches: Create a switch for each device to block or allow its Internet access. When off, the Livebox schedules are not polled and the existing switches are removed.

incomplete_device_info.message: The Livebox returned incomplete device information (serial number: {serial}, product class: {product_class}).

update_failed.message: Error while fetching data from the Livebox: {error}

wan_access_unlock_failed.message: Failed to unlock WAN access of {name} ({key}).

wan_access_lock_failed.message: Failed to lock WAN access of {name} ({key}).

communication_error.message: Error while communicating with the Livebox: {error}

remove_call_missed.name: Remove missed calls
remove_call_missed.description: Removes a missed call, or all calls when no call ID is given.

call_id.name: Call ID
call_id.description: ID of the call, shown in the attributes of the missed call binary sensor. Leave empty to remove all calls.

config_entry_id.name: Livebox
config_entry_id.description: Livebox whose call list is cleared. All of them if omitted.
